item.title: Morocco Overhauls the Legal Profession, Makes Impersonating a Lawyer a Prison Offense
item.description: A new law rewrites the rules for who can practice law in Morocco and criminalizes impersonating a lawyer, alongside a judicial appointments fix and a Settat water project.

item.title: Morocco's Top Court Blocks Government From Picking the Judiciary's Own Senior Staff
item.description: Morocco’s Constitutional Court blocks the executive from appointing senior officials inside the judiciary’s own governing body, while the state launches four new AI and digital-transformation institutes under the ‘Jazari’ brand.

item.title: Morocco Suspends Bread Wheat Import Duty as Global Grain Costs Bite
item.description: Morocco toggles its bread wheat import duty to manage prices, secures water-stress financing from the Islamic Development Bank, and recognizes foreign medical and architecture diplomas for Moroccans trained abroad.
